title: Freeze ecosystem ownership
goal: Record the established Styio, Pafio, Platform, and Vityo ownership boundary.
description: Styio owns compiler results, Pafio owns project workflows, Platform owns hosted services, and Vityo consumes separate owner contracts.

acceptance_criteria.text: The local ecosystem contract gate validates the current owner and consumer documents.

title: Select the release scope
goal: Decide which completed capabilities belong in the next fixed-revision candidate.
description: Choose the current functional baseline or name specific optimization checkpoints; do not absorb unrelated backlog merely because it exists in the roadmap.
status_reason: Awaiting maintainer feedback on the next release boundary.

acceptance_criteria.text: The release scope names included capabilities, explicit exclusions, participating repositories, and the candidate-freeze condition.

title: Run fixed-revision release acceptance
goal: Validate one immutable ecosystem candidate without compatibility shims.
description: Freeze participating revisions, run each affected owner full regression once, then run one cross-repository matrix and route failures back to the smallest owner closure.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every participating revision is immutable, each affected repository passes one final regression, and one cross-repository matrix passes against exactly those revisions.
